trap.label: certeza excessiva
trap.wrong: This is the cause of the flood.
trap.right: This is probably one cause of the flood.
trap.why: Em português afirmamos causas sem ressalva (“esta é a causa”). Em texto acadêmico em inglês, use probably, one of, may para não superafirmar.

mcq.q: Which sentence is least certain about the weather?
Which word best softens “always” in a river description?

fix.wrong: Everyone knows the forecast is wrong.
fix.right: Many people think the forecast is wrong.

fix.wrong: The clouds suggest it will to rain.
fix.right: The clouds suggest it will rain.
